title: repro instances start each area without auto-memory or a previous area's scratch
goal: bench_repro.instance_env sets CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY to 1 (public/claude/settings-and-scopes.md:39) and leaves the instances' --settings value exactly the operator's; it drops KB_ROOTS and every other variable kbcommon reads to find roots outside the clone; reset_clone removes the ignored files a previous area left (git clean -x) except the clone's pack index cache, and removes the git worktrees registered under the clone's _cache; the setup and run parts of test_bench.py prove each (no new test id)

run:
import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();g=lambda c,*a:subprocess.run(['git','-C',c,'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@t','-c','core.hooksPath=/dev/null',*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
w=os.path.join(t,'w');os.makedirs(w);g(w,'init','-q','-b','main');open(os.path.join(w,'.gitignore'),'w').write('_cache/\n');g(w,'add','-A');g(w,'commit','-qm','s')
o=os.path.join(t,'o.git');g(t,'clone','-q','--bare',w,o);c=os.path.join(t,'c');g(t,'clone','-q',o,c)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(c,'_cache','ts-scripts'));open(os.path.join(c,'_cache','kbindex-x.sqlite'),'w').write('i');open(os.path.join(c,'_cache','ts-scripts','a.py'),'w').write('x')
b.reset_clone(c,dict(os.environ))
keep=os.path.exists(os.path.join(c,'_cache','kbindex-x.sqlite'));gone=not os.path.exists(os.path.join(c,'_cache','ts-scripts','a.py'))
print('index kept',keep,'scratch gone',gone);sys.exit(0 if keep and gone else 1)
